summary: Adopt the go-archcheck checks. architecture/model.yaml models each package of the module as a go-archcheck layer and component. Design record 0001 states the initial model, with its reservation tag design/0001 for issue 229. make archcheck runs go-archcheck at a pinned version with the reservation tags of origin and, with a comparison commit, the base model and design records. make archcheck-reserve reserves the next design number. The Architecture CI job runs make archcheck with the same comparison commit as tools/architecture. The existing model, checker, and baseline do not change. No Go package, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: Existing modeled trust boundaries remain. make archcheck runs go-archcheck through go run at a pinned module version, as make vuln runs govulncheck. The go command downloads the module and, when needed, the Go toolchain that the module requires. The check fetches the design/NNNN tags from origin with read access. go-archcheck loads the packages of the module with the go command; it runs no test and no repository code, and it sends no source. make archcheck-reserve is a developer command, not a CI step: it creates a tag through the GitHub API with the GH_TOKEN of the developer.
